rfq.title: RFQ Guide
rfq.intro: I will collect the core details needed for a useful quotation.

steps.question: What product, spare part, or system do you need?
What is the application or site problem?
Where is the project or delivery location?
How urgent is it: breakdown, this week, planning, or just comparing options?
What phone or email should the team use to follow up?

pump-selection.title: Pump Selection Guide
pump-selection.intro: I will ask the main pump-sizing questions so the team can recommend the right direction.

steps.question: What is the pump application: borehole, booster, transfer, dosing, wastewater, pool, or another duty?
What flow rate do you need, or what demand should the pump serve?
What head, pressure, lift height, or distance is involved?
What fluid is being pumped, and is it clean water, chemical, sludge, wastewater, or something else?
What power supply is available: single phase, three phase, solar, generator, or unknown?
Where will it be installed, and is it a new system or replacement?

water-treatment.title: Water Treatment Guide
water-treatment.intro: I will help narrow the treatment direction before the team sizes a system.

steps.question: What is the water source: borehole, municipal, river, seawater, wastewater, or industrial process water?
What problem are you trying to solve: salts/TDS, sediment, color, smell, bacteria, hardness, iron, fluoride, or another issue?
What will the treated water be used for: drinking, process, boiler, irrigation, pool, lab, or general supply?
What flow rate or daily volume do you need?
Do you have a water analysis report or test results?
